races.title: State Assembly, District 60
races.note: The top two finishers from the Nov 3, 2026 count. Everyone else in this race is coming.

cands.name: Corey A Jackson
cands.bio: Democratic member of the California State Assembly for District 60 since December 2022. Previously served on the Riverside County Board of Education (2020-2022). Worked as a district representative for a state senator, a field representative for a U.S. Senator and a district director for a U.S. House member. Owns Blueprint Group.

endorsements.text: Ballotpedia lists 2026 endorsements including the Democratic Party of California, Working Families Party, California Federation of Labor Unions, California Nurses Association, California Teachers Association, California Environmental Voters, Equality California and Courage California.

cands.gaps: We found no documented statements or actions by Jackson on data centers, homestead property taxes, limits on investor or foreign land buying, growth and land protection, H-1B and immigration enforcement, police and public order, gun laws, abortion, or school choice and teacher pay. The one page we had listed his sponsored bills only as a table without content, so we could not report any specific bill. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in any year, so no self-described campaign themes were available. We found no news reports of controversies and no information on any foreign ties. His age and when, if ever, he lived outside California are not stated.

local.label: Roots 90: Ballotpedia says he was born in Rialto, California, graduated from Rialto High School, earned his bachelor's degree at CSU San Bernardino, and lives in Moreno Valley; the page gives no explicit statement about his upbringing, so the score uses the 90 tier (raised in California, with a California-area high school record).

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: State Assemblymember since December 2022, serving on the Budget Committee in both terms. Earlier he was a Riverside County Board of Education trustee, and he worked as a district representative for a state senator, a field representative for a U.S. Senator and a district director for a U.S. House member. He owns Blueprint Group.
qual.why: He has more than three years of prior legislative service, including budget committee work, plus legislative staff careers and local elected office, which fits the high band for writing law and the state budget. A committee seat alone was not counted.

cands.name: Ed Delgado
cands.bio: Republican candidate for California State Assembly District 60 in 2026. He advanced from the June 2, 2026 nonpartisan primary, placing second behind incumbent Democrat Corey Jackson.

endorsements.text: Ballotpedia lists the Republican Party of California and Reform California among his endorsements, along with several informal social-media voter-guide groups.

cands.gaps: We could not confirm his birthplace, where he grew up, when he moved to California, or his work history. The only source we had includes candidate-survey answers that describe running for Wisconsin's 57th Assembly District and serving as a Waushara County Board Supervisor. That does not match this California race, so we left out everything from that survey, including his stated positions on policy, taxes, guns, immigration and data centers. We found no documented actions in office, public statements on land or development, controversies, or foreign ties for him in California.

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: Not established. The only page available mixes California race data with survey answers about a Wisconsin office, so his work history could not be confirmed as belonging to this candidate.
